android_runtime_findings.basis: ELF.note.android.ident for both arm64-v8a andx86_64; DT_NEEDED lists contain no libc++_shared.so. Official build scripts leave ANDROID_STL unset; official Android documentation says CMake defaults to c++_static.
android_runtime_findings.r27d_retrieval: Bounded HTTPS range requests to official839006233-byteZIP read its1475046-bytecentraldirectory and selected notice/version entries only. Entry length and CRC32 verified. No complete-toolchain download performed.

r30_local_sdk.evidence: Installed official SDK source.properties matches embedded ELF revision. These local notice bytes are identified, not yet imported into publication.

windows_runtime_findings.imports: Both JNI DLLs import onnxruntime.dll and KERNEL32.dll; no MSVCP/VCRUNTIME imports. ORT DLLs import only Windows OS DLLs.
windows_runtime_findings.source_configuration: Sherpa2.0.1 default SHERPA_ONNX_USE_STATIC_CRT=ON, CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY selects /MT for Release. Official Windows JNI workflows do not override the default.
windows_runtime_findings.status: Unconfirmed exact staticCRT/STL build/version and corresponding vendor license/notice provenance. Do not substitute a currentmain or a single VS2022 notice for both variants.

source_availability.text:
Eigen source availability

The pinned sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 source configuration references Eigen 5.0.1. Eigen is primarily licensed under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; retain its accompanying license and copyright notices.

The unmodified Eigen 5.0.1 Source Code Form is publicly available at:
https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/5.0.1/eigen-5.0.1.tar.gz
SHA-256: e9c326dc8c05cd1e044c71f30f1b2e34a6161a3b6ecf445d56b53ff1669e3dec

Download the archive above and verify that SHA-256 before extracting it. The archive includes the source files and their MPL 2.0 and other applicable license notices. The included COPYING.README describes the licensing; COPYING.MPL2 contains the MPL 2.0 text. Siren also retains Eigen's LICENSE and COPYING.* files under META-INF/siren/licenses/eigen/.

The inspected sherpa-onnx 2.0.1 cmake/eigen.cmake downloads this exact archive without a source-patching step. Siren copies the upstream runtime binary bytes without modifying them. This statement supplies a source location; it does not change the incomplete status of the separate native-binary redistribution audit.
